Question 1
?

The quartic polynomial P(x) has roots x1=x2=x3=x4=2, and the coefficient of the quartic term is 2. Find P(x).

a
2x4−8x3−36x2−64x+32
b
2x4+16x3+48x2+64x+32
c
2x4+8x3−36x2−64x+16
d
2x4−16x3+48x2−64x+32
e
2x4+10x3+48x2+64x+16
